system: civil law; judicial review of legislative acts

constitution.amend: proposed by the Folketing (Parliament) with consent of the government; passage requires approval by the next Folketing following a general election, approval by simple majority vote of at least 40% of voters in a referendum, and assent of the chief of state

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of the court president and 18 judges)
courts.judges: judges appointed by the monarch upon the recommendation of the Minister of Justice, with the advice of the Judicial Appointments Council, a 6-member independent body of judges and lawyers; judges appointed for life with retirement at age 70
courts.lower: Special Court of Indictment and Revision; 2 High Courts; Maritime and Commercial Court; county courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Denmark

world: accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction with reservations; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
